body: Full-duplex speech language models continuously accumulate acoustic key-value (KV) states, making long-running interactions memory-intensive. During listening, the model can finish processing an audio unit before the next arrives; we term the remaining interval listening-time slack. We propose acoustic-to-text KV compression, which introduces a transcription side channel to convert incoming speech into compact textual memory within this interval. When the cache exceeds a target budget during inference, older acoustic states are evicted while transcripts and recent acoustic context remain. We train the side channel with LoRA using cross-entropy on transcription segments. To preserve listening and speaking behavior, we apply knowledge distillation to the original model's token-level output distributions at native prediction positions. On ten-minute LongSpeech sessions, our MiniCPM-o 4.5 implementation reduces peak streaming KV-cache size by 64.6% compared with the same model without eviction. The proposed method also improves transcription, temporal question answering, and summarization over the baseline. Full-Duplex-Bench evaluations further show comparable pause-handling, turn-taking, and interruption performance.
summaryZh: 全双工语音语言模型会持续累积声学键值（KV）状态，导致长交互内存密集。本文提出声学到文本的KV压缩方法，利用监听时间的空闲间隔，通过转录副作用将传入语音转换为紧凑的文本内存。在缓存超出目标预算时驱逐较旧的声学状态。实验表明，该方法在MiniCPM-o 4.5实现中将峰值流式KV缓存大小减少了64.6%，同时提升了转录和问答性能。

glossary.explanationZh: 全双工语音模型，支持同时进行语音输入监听和语音输出交互的模型
键值缓存，大模型推理中用于存储历史注意力键值对以加速生成的缓存机制
声学到文本KV压缩，将历史声学状态转换为紧凑文本以节省内存的技术
知识 distillation，将大型模型或原始模型的行为迁移到压缩后模型的训练方法
